item.title: Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

Under UK law and WHO guidelines, my HIV status is treated as a protected medical condition. The post Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Ranau Hospital Crisis: Doctors Working 48 To 72 Straight Hours — Medical Officer
item.description:
